title: PeptSol: A Translational Benchmark for Protected-Peptide Solubility in Drug Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2611.00749v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Liquid-phase peptide synthesis (LPPS) offers a scalable route to peptide manufacturing, but route development still depends on empirical solvent screens because each protected intermediate must be soluble for reaction and recoverable for purification. The protecting groups, terminal modifications, and noncanonical residues that govern this behaviour are poorly represented in existing peptide property benchmarks, limiting the ability to develop and rigorously evaluate molecular representation models for LPPS-relevant prediction tasks. We introduce PeptSol, an open benchmark of 1388 hand-curated protected-peptide solubility measurements with chemistry-aware splits. The measurements span only 84 parent sequences and 101 protected structures, and 92.5% come from a single historical programme. Across seven frozen molecular encoders, the best macro-F1 is 0.843 on binary solubility for the historical subset under a peptide-held-out split; t

translated_title: PeptSol：面向药物制造中保护态肽溶解度的转化型基准数据集
translated_abstract: 液相肽合成（LPPS）为肽类药物制造提供了可规模化的途径，但工艺路线的开发仍然依赖于经验性的溶剂筛选，因为每个保护态中间体必须可溶解以进行反应，且可回收用于纯化。决定这一行为的保护基团、末端修饰和非天然残基在现有的肽性质基准数据集中代表性不足，限制了针对LPPS相关预测任务开发和严格评估分子表示模型的能力。我们提出了PeptSol，这是一个包含1388条人工整理的保护态肽溶解度测量数据、并采用化学感知数据划分的开放基准数据集。这些测量数据仅涵盖84个母序列和101个保护态结构，其中92.5%来自单一历史项目。在七个冻结分子编码器上，在按肽划分（peptide-held-out split）的历史子集的二元溶解度任务中，最佳宏观F1分数为0.843……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了PeptSol——首个面向液相肽合成工艺开发的保护态肽溶解度开放基准数据集，包含1388条人工整理的溶解度测量数据并采用化学感知划分，弥补了现有肽性质基准在保护基团、末端修饰和非天然残基方面的不足，为分子表示模型提供了严格的评估平台。
en_tdlr: PeptSol is an open benchmark of 1388 hand-curated protected-peptide solubility measurements with chemistry-aware splits, addressing the underrepresentation of protecting groups, terminal modifications, and noncanonical residues in existing benchmarks and enabling rigorous evaluation of molecular encoders for LPPS-relevant prediction tasks.
